ja: 轟の黒き大丈夫“太史慈ドム”がBB戦士に登場！ サポートメカ“鋼甲機（ヴァルヴァロ）”が付属。 鋼甲機は太史慈と合体し、鋼甲形態、鋼鎧装形態、さらに撃鋼形態に変形可能。
en: Todoroki's black okay "Taishi Jidom " appears in BB Senshi! Support mecha " Steel Armor Machine (Valvaro)" is included. The steel armored machine can be combined with Taishi Ci and transformed into steel armored form, steel armored form, and even steel hammered form.
